text.hudcompass.waypoint_editor.title: Waypoint Editor
config.hudcompass.title: HUD Compass
config.hudcompass.alwaysShowLabels.toolt: If enabled, the labels on the compass will always be visible. If disabled, only the waypoint closest to the center of the compass shows its name.
config.hudcompass.alwaysShowFocusedLabel: If disabled, the waypoint closest to the center of the compass will not show its label, and sneaking will be required to display it.
config.hudcompass.showAllLabelsOnSneak.t: If disabled, sneaking will only show the label of the waypoint closest to the center of the compass.
config.hudcompass.animateLabels.tooltip: If disabled, labels will not animate as the icons do.
config.hudcompass.displayWhen.tooltip: Choose when the compass is visible.
config.hudcompass.waypointFadeDistance.t: The distance at which waypoints start to fade. Meaningless if Waypoint View Distance is 0. If this value is greater than or equal to that, waypoints will never fade.
config.hudcompass.waypointViewDistance.t: The distance at which waypoints stop drawing. If set to 0, waypoints will never disappear.
config.hudcompass.showLocatorBarWaypoint: If disabled, icons from the vanilla locator bar will not be shown on the compass.
Choose when the vanilla locator bar is hidden.
config.hudcompass.enableVanillaMapIntegr: If disabled, vanilla map banner/decoration waypoints won't be displayed on the compass.
config.hudcompass.enableSpawnPointWaypoi: If disabled, the bed/respawn-anchor spawn point location will not be shown.
config.hudcompass.enableJourneymapIntegr: If disabled, JourneyMap waypoints won't be displayed on the compass.
config.hudcompass.playerDisplay.tooltip: Choose how the compass shows other players.
config.hudcompass.disableServerHello.too: If enabled, hosting this world/server will not advertise waypoint sync to clients, making them work in client-only mode. Only takes effect on the hosting side.
